title: Diagnostic
description: One structured finding (LSP-shaped) carried in a result envelope's `diagnostics` array (CLI-SPEC §4). Built to be corrective — detect → locate → repair: a stable `code`, a `where`, and (for recoverable errors) a `fix`.

source.description: KERNEL = checkConsistency problem; PRECHECK = a kit pre-check; LINT = valid-but-suspicious advisory; ENVIRONMENT = toolchain note

code.description: the MVK_* (kernel) or RK_* (rulekit/structure) code; absent for some kernel problems

where.description: the locus — a rule-condition site (rule/operator/span) OR a structure site (path/arg)

path.description: a model-element path (structure locus — modelkit ops)

span.description: [start, end] char offsets into the condition text, when known

fix.description: the actionable repair — an applicable replacement or a discovery command; present for recoverable errors

explain.description: the operator meaning / rationale (the `why`), when helpful
